resources.string: Definitions or the current boot changed. Close this confirmation and review the updated selection before continuing.
These tools list enabled paths only. Path edits create a new definition and do not transfer its name, note or group. Return to saved definitions to manage disabled items.
Search path, name, note or group
Definitions are not fully verified. Refresh before making changes; retained rows may be outdated.
Managed ownership is unavailable or unknown. Names, notes and groups can still be edited; runtime changes are unavailable.
This changes all %1$d definitions in this exact group, including items hidden by search or filters. Individual runtime changes may partially fail.
This path belongs to a stable definition. To change it, create and verify a separate definition, then explicitly remove the old one.
UTF-8 limits: name and group 128 bytes each; note 1024 bytes. Whitespace is preserved.
Check the path and field byte limits. NUL and invalid text are not supported; input is retained.
This exact path is already defined, including disabled definitions.
This definition has been removed. Your draft is retained; it will not recreate the definition automatically.
Saved definitions changed. Review the current values below, then choose how to continue.
Keep my input for this version
Saved; selected registrations match. Binding and application visibility need separate checks.
Definition details saved; runtime was not changed.
Saved, but runtime changes are partial or unconfirmed. Refresh before retrying.
This change was not saved. Refresh and check the reason before trying again.
Result unknown. Input is retained. Query current definitions and operation history before retrying.
Only the first 64 item results are shown. Counts cover the whole operation; refresh the full list for current state.
The batch stopped. Refresh, inspect current states, then explicitly select any remaining changes. No change is automatically replayed.
